sermons.title: Day 1: HEALING STREAMS LIVE HEALING SERVICES WITH PASTOR CHRIS || MARCH 2026
summary: The sermon demonstrates God's healing power through multiple testimonies of physical and spiritual healing, emphasizing that Jesus Christ provides authority and power to command disease and demonic oppression to leave human bodies.

The pastor teaches that righteousness is a gift from God received through faith in Jesus Christ, not earned through works or obedience to the law, and that believers have the authority to refuse sickness and command healing in Jesus's name.

Christians are responsible stewards of their bodies and must exercise faith and speak God's authority over illness rather than passively accepting disease, as demonstrated through numerous healings of cancer, paralysis, blindness, and various afflictions.

sermons.title: DAY 3: HEALING STREAMS LIVE HEALING SERVICE WITH PASTOR CHRIS || OCTOBER 26TH, 2025
summary: The sermon centers on a healing streams live service where Pastor Chris ministers healing to the sick globally through prayer and the power of the Holy Spirit, demonstrating that Jesus came to destroy the works of the devil and heal all who are oppressed.

Multiple testimonies are shared of people receiving miraculous healings from various conditions including anxiety, deafness, cancer, back pain, and demonic oppression, emphasizing that God's healing power is available to all who believe and call upon Jesus.

The message encourages faith and expectation in God's healing grace, teaching that sickness is a work of the devil that has been defeated by Christ, and that believers can receive their miracles through faith, prayer, and connection to God's word regardless of physical location.

sermons.title: Pastor Chris' Message at RHAPATHON 2025 || DAY 3 EVENING || SEPTEMBER 17TH 2025
summary: The sermon clarifies that believers receive the complete Holy Spirit at salvation and do not need multiple anointings or special empowerments, as the anointing represents consecration and the fullness of God's power already dwelling within them.

The blessing of the Lord is a tangible spiritual force that produces prosperity, health, favor, and supernatural supply independent of external circumstances, and believers should walk in consciousness of this blessing through declaration and faith.

Christians are called to think differently from the world, meditate on God's word, and understand their true identity as blessed, victorious, and prosperous heirs of Abraham who carry the blessing wherever they go.

sermons.title: Day 1: HEALING SCHOOL LIVE HEALING SERVICE WITH PASTOR CHRIS || OCTOBER 24TH, 2025
summary: The service emphasizes God's compassion toward the suffering and His power to heal through faith, illustrated by biblical accounts of Jesus healing the leper and raising the widow's son.

Participants are encouraged to believe and actively participate in receiving healing, with testimonies from previous services demonstrating instantaneous healings of cancer, heart disease, arthritis, and various chronic conditions across multiple nations.

The message calls believers to respond to God's love and healing virtue flowing through the service, assuring that distance and circumstance are no barriers to divine healing when one believes and receives in faith.

sermons.title: DAY 2: HEALING SCHOOL LIVE HEALING SERVICE WITH PASTOR CHRIS || OCTOBER 25TH, 2025
summary: The Healing Streams live healing services demonstrate God's power to heal all sickness and disease through faith in Jesus Christ, with testimonies flowing from every continent as the gospel reaches nations through translation and multimedia platforms.
Sickness is identified as oppression of the devil, and Jesus destroyed the works of the devil through His death and resurrection, making healing available to all who believe and receive it by faith.

Participants are called to active faith, expectation, and participation in the healing services, with multiple testimonies showing instantaneous healings across diverse conditions and geographic locations worldwide.

sermons.title: Day 2: HEALING STREAMS LIVE HEALING SERVICES WITH PASTOR CHRIS || DAY 2|| MARCH 2026
summary: The sermon demonstrates the power of Jesus Christ to heal all manner of sickness and disease through the Holy Spirit's authority, with numerous testimonies of miraculous healings from various conditions worldwide.

The speaker emphasizes that eternal life is not merely about duration but represents the organic and existential attributes of deity—the life and nature of God made manifest in Christ and available to believers.
Believers are called to understand their identity as chosen, royal, and special people of God, predestined to walk in good works and live the abundant life God has prepared for them.

sermons.title: DAY 1: HEALING STREAMS LIVE HEALING SERVICES WITH PASTOR CHRIS || JULY 2026
summary: The sermon showcases multiple testimonies of miraculous healings through the Healing Streams ministry, emphasizing that God's power transcends medical limitations and distance.

Participants from around the world testify to being healed from various conditions including cancer, diabetes, paralysis, and chronic pain through faith in Jesus Christ and participation in the healing services.

The message emphasizes that believers receive healing through faith, renewing their minds with God's word, and trusting in the resurrection power of Jesus Christ for complete restoration of body and spirit.

sermons.title: GLOBAL COMMUNION SERVICE WITH PASTOR CHRIS || JANUARY 2026
summary: The sermon emphasizes that believers must understand and walk in God's truth rather than relying on assumptions, traditions, or information from worldly sources that nullify Scripture's power in their lives.

The manifestation of truth occurs when God's Word becomes the controlling force of one's thinking and behavior, working through believers just as the Holy Spirit manifests spiritual gifts through individuals.

As 2026 is declared the year of manifestation, Christians are called to win souls urgently before the rapture, focusing on reaching the lost rather than repeatedly targeting those already close to them.

sermons.title: DAY 2: HEALING STREAMS LIVE HEALING SERVICES WITH PASTOR CHRIS || JULY 2026
summary: The Healing Streams Live Healing Services is a global three-day event (July 24-26, 2026) where Pastor Chris ministers healing and miracles to billions of people worldwide through various platforms.
Participants are encouraged to exercise faith in the name of Jesus Christ, participate actively in worship and prayer, and expect divine healing regardless of their physical condition or location.

Numerous testimonies demonstrate God's power to heal cancer, paralysis, heart disease, blindness, spinal injuries, and other conditions instantaneously through the proclamation of Jesus's name and the Holy Spirit's power.

sermons.title: DAY 3: HEALING STREAMS LIVE HEALING SERVICES WITH PASTOR CHRIS || JULY 2026
summary: The sermon uses the Galilean wedding tradition as a metaphor for Christ's return, explaining that only God the Father knows the day and hour when Jesus will come for His bride, the Church.
Just as a Galilean bridegroom's father alone determined when the wedding would occur, only God the Father can send Jesus to retrieve His bride, and believers must remain constantly ready.

The message emphasizes that healing and wholeness are available now through faith in Jesus Christ, demonstrated through numerous testimonies of miraculous healings during the Healing Streams services.

sermons.title: "Jesus sent me to bring healing to you!" - Pastor Chris declares as he prays for you.
summary: The speaker declares that Jesus sent him to bring healing to all nations, emphasizing that God's love and power can heal any condition regardless of circumstance.
Through the power of the Holy Spirit, the speaker commands infirmities, diseases, and demonic forces to leave people's bodies, calling for faith and physical participation in receiving healing.
Believers are encouraged to thank God for their healing and share their testimonies as a way to glorify God and maintain the blessings they receive.

sermons.title: PASTOR CHRIS' MESSAGE AT RHAPATHON 2025 || GRAND FINALE || SEPTEMBER 19TH 2025
summary: The believer's true identity and power come from understanding that they are born after the last Adam—a life-giving spirit living by the law of the spirit of life, not the law of sin and death.

Words carry spiritual power and must be spoken with revelation knowledge; Jesus demonstrated this mastery, and believers who understand their heavenly origin should speak life and operate from the exhaustless riches of Christ.

Transformation occurs through renewing the mind with God's word, moving from mere information to revelation knowledge illuminated by the Holy Spirit, enabling believers to walk in victory, prosperity, and the fullness of the gospel's blessings.

sermons.title: GLOBAL COMMUNION SERVICE WITH PASTOR CHRIS || MARCH 2026
summary: The sermon emphasizes that March is a month of focus, calling believers to concentrate their attention on God's purpose and word without distraction, using multiple scriptures to establish that staying focused on Christ and His calling leads to success and prosperity.

The pastor teaches that discovering and living out God's specific purpose for one's life is essential, and that this requires maintaining unwavering focus on Jesus and His word rather than being swayed by worldly circumstances or distractions.

The sermon includes teaching on the communion as the actual body and blood of Christ (transubstantiation), emphasizing its power for healing and restoration, and calls believers to give special seeds for world evangelization as part of their commitment to spreading the gospel.

sermons.title: HEALING STREAMS LIVE HEALING SERVICE WITH PASTOR CHRIS || JULY 18TH 2025
summary: The Healing Streams live healing services is a global three-day event where Pastor Chris ministers God's healing power to millions across all nations through prayer, worship, and the proclamation of Scripture.
Participants from over 230 nations experience divine healing, deliverance, and salvation as the power of God flows through various viewing centers, homes, hospitals, and churches worldwide.
The program emphasizes that healing is the right of every believer as a child of Abraham, and that salvation through Christ is available to all who receive it during the services.

sermons.title: GLOBAL COMMUNION SERVICE WITH PASTOR CHRIS || OCTOBER EDITION
summary: Believers who have received God's kingdom are called to enforce His will on earth through spiritual warfare, prayer, and decrees, casting out demonic forces that resist the gospel.

The sermon exposes systematic deception in the food industry—including fluoride in milk, fake olive oil, adulterated honey, processed meats with nitrites, and sugar addiction—as part of a satanic agenda to harm populations.
October is declared a month of spreading and possessing territories through faith, giving, and speaking God's word, culminating in a nationwide prayer crusade for Nigeria on November 7th.

sermons.title: HEALING STREAMS LIVE HEAING SERVICE WITH PASTOR CHRIS || MARCH 14TH 2025
summary: The Healing Streams live healing services is a global supernatural event where God's healing power flows to believers worldwide through prayer, faith, and participation, with miracles occurring simultaneously across nations.

Participants are encouraged to engage actively through worship, prayer, and faith-filled action, believing that Jesus Christ brings complete restoration to body, mind, and spirit regardless of the nature or duration of affliction.

Testimonies from around the world demonstrate God's power to heal chronic diseases, broken bones, mental illness, and even raise the dead, confirming that healing belongs to all who believe and participate in the program.

sermons.title: GLOBAL ROYAL THANKSGIVING SERVICE WITH PASTOR CHRIS || DECEMBER 7TH  2025
summary: This global thanksgiving service celebrates the ministry and impact of Pastor Chris Kilome, with testimonies of transformed lives, healed bodies, and expanded gospel outreach across nations.

The service emphasizes the value of every soul, the power of the gospel, and the importance of steadfast service to God, drawing from daily devotional teachings on grace, purpose, and spiritual maturity.

Participants express gratitude for healing miracles, church growth, leadership development through the International School of Ministry, and the global reach of the gospel through various outreach programs and media.

sermons.title: DAY 1: GLOBAL DAY OF PRAYER WITH PASTOR CHRIS || NOVEMBER 2025
summary: The sermon emphasizes the power of united prayer and intercession for church impact, national leaders, and global salvation, drawing on scriptural foundations for strategic prayer.
Participants are called to pray for leaders at all levels of government and society, with the promise that prayer produces peace, prevents corruption, and establishes God's will in nations.

Testimonies of healing, deliverance, and divine encounters demonstrate God's power working through faith and the laying on of hands, encouraging believers to activate their authority in Christ for transformation.

sermons.title: DAY 1:YOUR LOVEWORLD SPECIALS SEASON 11 PHASE 4 WITH PASTOR CHRIS
summary: The sermon teaches that believers engage in spiritual warfare through prayer, fasting, and prophetic declarations to combat demonic forces and advance God's kingdom on earth.
Using the biblical account of Deborah and Barak defeating Sisera, the pastor emphasizes that the real battle occurs in the heavenly realm and determines earthly outcomes.

Christians are called to exercise kingdom authority with divine wisdom, recognizing they possess an unshakable kingdom and must deploy spiritual weapons to neutralize evil agendas targeting nations, children, and the church.

sermons.title: DAY 1: GLOBAL PRAYER AND FASTING WITH PASTOR CHRIS || FEBRUARY 24TH 2026
summary: Christians must engage in spiritual warfare through prayer and prophecy, recognizing that Satan plants agents of deception near leaders to prevent them from hearing God's word.
Believers are called to exercise themselves in godliness and spiritual discipline, which is more profitable than physical exercise and enables them to live as the express image of Christ.

During the upcoming Healing Streams event in March 2026, God's power will manifest miracles of healing worldwide as believers abide in Christ and His word, demonstrating His sovereignty over sickness and infirmity.

sermons.title: GLOBAL COMMUNION SERVICE WITH PASTOR CHRIS || NOVEMBER EDITION
summary: This global communion service emphasizes the power of Christ's broken body and poured-out life through the sacrament, declaring spiritual protection and wholeness for all participants.

The ministry celebrates October's victories in spreading the gospel and possessing territories through healing services, prayer, and fasting, while preparing for November's major conferences and outreach initiatives.

The final push toward completing the full preaching of the gospel culminates in December's Reach Out World campaign, mobilizing believers globally to distribute Rhapsody of Realities in all known languages and formats.

sermons.title: DAY 1: HOLY LAND TOUR WITH PASTOR CHRIS AND PASTOR BENNY SERVICE ||  DECEMBER 10TH, 2025
summary: Pastor Benny Hinn teaches that visiting the Holy Land is fundamentally about encountering Jesus Christ and experiencing His presence through Scripture, not merely touring historical sites or engaging in political debates about the land.

God's promises to Israel are eternal and unbreakable—as long as God exists, Israel will exist—and these promises are fulfilled through Jesus the Messiah, who is God incarnate and the focus of all biblical prophecy.

Believers should prioritize loving Jesus and understanding Scripture first, which naturally produces love for Israel and its people, and should demonstrate Christ's love to all people in the land regardless of ethnicity or background.

sermons.title: PRAISE NIGHT 28 WITH PASTOR CHRIS || MAY 24TH 2026
summary: This praise night service centers on declaring the lordship and sovereignty of Jesus Christ across all nations through worship, song, and prayer, with emphasis on translating worship songs into multiple languages to reach global audiences.

The service features extended worship segments with songs celebrating Christ's majesty, government, and authority over all earthly kingdoms, interspersed with scripture readings affirming God's greatness and faithfulness.
Participants are encouraged to sing declarations of Christ's lordship everywhere, believing that these words released in worship carry spiritual power to bring salvation and healing to nations.

sermons.title: Pastor Chris:: Who are The Roman Catholics? Who are the Protestants? Why did the church split?
summary: The speaker discusses the announcement of a new pope and uses it as a springboard to explain what unites all Christians across denominations despite historical divisions and doctrinal differences.

Essential Christian beliefs—including Christ's virgin birth, deity, sacrificial death, resurrection, ascension, and the Holy Spirit's indwelling presence—transcend denominational boundaries and define true Christianity.
While churches have split over practices and doctrines contrary to Scripture, believers from Catholic, Protestant, and other traditions who hold these core truths are united as one body in Christ.
